In char 3 F=XYZ Q³, Q=X²+Y²+Z² smooth; axes meet it transversely at six points, giving nine reduced-support nodes, and Jacobian scheme V(Q³) plus vertices. Signed labels have collision weights (4,2,2,2,1,1,1) mod 2 and stay distinct mod 3. Independently expanded F and all three partial derivatives modulo 2 and 3 with SymPy; they match the exact nonreduced ideals. Boundary limitation: only the fixed integral equation, not intrinsic stable reduction or positive-characteristic freeness.
